note: Routes, services and (from 2026-09-06) MCP surfaces that read `sub` off the verified token and never resolve the caller. Triaged 2026-09-04, the day the gate was written, in groups: the units ARE grouped, since twelve dispute audit entries are one line with twelve event names. Every group's pattern was read in the source first, and the generator refused to write a file with any unit outside a named group. Two verdicts appear. The ones that hand the value to a call carry the reason that call needs it — an ACTOR in an audit trail, the FALLBACK argument to resolveGhii, the caller's OWN GAII on an agent-only door. The rest say NOT HANDED TO A CALL, which is a mechanical fact rather than a judgement: a comparison, a log line or a presence test cannot file data under the wrong identity. One door found by this gate was fixed instead of listed: GET /v1/apps/:owner/:filename answered 402 PURCHASE_REQUIRED to the buyer, the buyer's agent AND the seller, because it asked for a licence under `sub` while every receipt is keyed on the owner coordinate (utils/gaii.ts ownerCoordinate, and test/e2e-app-store-license.ts now covers the download). A unit leaves this file by being fixed or by someone deciding its reason is wrong — not by re-seeding, which would forgive the lot.
